notes.title: Combat Revamp
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161922/e808c75296aea9e0442f534e0cbda7001b3d9f10.png[/img]


Hello, Overseer!
    War has changed.
    But... War never changes.
    ...So maybe nothing's changed?
    But - no, something's definitely changed.

    What has changed, dear Overseer, is that the Combat Revamp that we've announced a long while ago has just come out, ready to be mastered by you! Among many changes and differences compared to the previous system, one is most definitely at the forefront that you will welcome:
[b]    Speed-Ups during missions now extend to walking speed as well![/b]

    No more sitting for ages, waiting for the elevator to reach a different floor, listening to cheesy music and not even able to exchange trivia about your cultures or recent happenings with your companions!
But there's so much more, too!

- Division of the battle field into 3 lines.
- Items will have unique stats spreads.
- Armor Penetration - new stat - the opposite of the fun penetration.
- Unique Combat behavior - weapons will not hit random enemies. Melee weapons will start mowing enemies on their front line while.
- Ranged weapons will prefer the back and middle enemy lines.
- New two-stat-based weapon types are now possible! First ones to be such weapons are the Bows.
- Auto-skill and auto-heal toggles!
- Combat UI improvements
- Indicating enemies' damage type (Melee, Ranged)
- Buffs and Debuffs effects will be displayed over the target's HP bar

    Still, not everything went as smoothly as we had hoped, so while we finish up a few kinks, [b]we had to temporarily disable Reforging [/b]- a decision made so you wouldn't lose your materials needlessly while we haven't finished tweaking them. We will bring it back as soon as possible, hopefully next week!
    Apart from any possible hotfixes, we are also working on important patches to further adjust the entirety of the system towards the Combat Revamp.
For now, though: prepare for your new reality of combat, Overseer, for War...[i] has not yet finished changing.[/i]

PS: Current version of the Combat Revamp has a slightly reduced enemy combat prowess. They will attack less often compared to your Champions. In the next updates their attacks will be brought back to the original design, which will be the same as you will see on your armaments.
Give it a go, let the new combat mechanics sink in, level up your girls and their equipment, fiddle around with skills and tactics. Don't forget to let us know what are your thoughts!
    
From the trenches,
    --The JNT Team

notes.title: Combat reavamp! Coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello, Overseer.

Today we launch new trust missions for Veneza, Frozen, Bańka & Chelsea. Few other missions also received minor tweeks to bring them closer to the new revamped formula. Make sure to beef those girls up before what's coming next! As we have been teasing for a while, the revamp of our combat is proceeding as planned, with the mechanics being rebuilt completely from the ground up. We want to keep you in the loop in terms of what changes this will bring to you:

[b]The combat is still automatic, but picking targets will no longer be a mostly random endeavor.[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, target priority will be determined based on the weapon itself, that is: weapons will now be targeted according to their type.
[*] Melee Weapons target the front of the enemy group first.
[*] Shotguns and Tesla Rifles target the middle line first, then the front line.
[*] Pistols and Rifles target the furthest line first, then the middle line.
[/list]
[b]This will allow you to create intricate attack scenarios and prepare for more difficult encounters to your optimal strength![/b]
[list]
[*] A new Initiative System will determine the order of combat.
[*] Initiative will be calculated using Champion Stats together with their equipment bonus
[*] Melee weapons give an Initiative based on Willpower and Agility
[*] Ranged weapons give an Initiative based on a combination of Willpower, Agility and Intelligence
[/list]
[b]No longer will the combat be based on who animates the fastest - now, you will need to prepare accordingly to what is ahead of you[/b]!

[list]
[*] WAIFU Stats now scale differently as well as provide clearer benefits
[*] Willpower, Agility and Intelligence are the main damage bonus stats. All weapons will indicate which stat they are using for bonus damage.
[*] Fortitude will determine the amount of Hit Points your Champion has.
[*] Utility is the Defense stat, against which incoming Damage will be reduced in different proportions for Melee and Ranged weapons, also dependent on the DEFense stat of your Equipment. Damage Reduction will be the topic of a later part of our Combat Revamp look-through.
[/list]
[b]Your stats will matter a lot more, not just your chosen "strongest" stat. Your old tactics will need updating, warmaster![/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons will now have a set choice of their base stats and their chosen Damage Bonus stat. Randomized weapon stats are on the way out.
[/list]
[b]From now on, weapons variety will be the name of the game! No more metal pipes for the entire squad![/b]

[b]This is but the first part of our series of informational messages regarding the combat revamp.[/b] Stay tuned for further information about this big, big undertaking that will shake up the foundations of the game to make it deeper, more involved, more interesting and much, much more fun!

With love,
    --The JNT Team

notes.title: Trust System and... Item changes soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161922/6da62aa5616f281ea9054f5f9415bb06745ba880.png[/img]

Hello, Overseer.

    We have heard your feedback in terms of our basic gameplay and combat and we are preparing some changes to address them, under the loving umbrella term of the [b]Combat Revamp[/b]!

    To get there, however, we need to first introduce a few changes to the rest of the current system so the Revamp fits in nicely, and the first change is coming soon, namely: [i][b]The Removal and Readjustment of the Trust System[/b][/i].

    Currently, introducing new (next) flirt levels for your beloved Champions met a giant wall with bold letters that spelled "[b]DESIGN LIMITATION[/b]". Not to mention, their Trust Missions became practically obsolete once they reached their max level!

    As a result, we have made the decision to trim the fat instead of leaving bits of meat dangling, and Trust Levels will be completely removed.

    To not make this throw out all of your progress with their trust, the Champion base levels will be adjusted accordingly to their Trust Levels, like so:

[b]Trust Level 1 - Champion Level 1
Trust Level 2 - Champion Level 5
Trust Level 3 - Champion Level 10
Trust Level 4 - Champion Level 15
Trust Level 5 - Champion Level 25[/b]

Flirt requirements will be replaced according to the same formula.

    This decision pulled a different problem behind it, and that is recalculating what resources you require to level them up, which we have adjusted, too.

    There are more changes incoming that are all about the Combat Revamp, but we put this one out first to ensure you will have extra time to familiarize yourself with the new levelling system.
[b]
THIS CHANGE WILL TAKE EFFECT ON TUESDAY, 23RD OF MAY AT SERVER RESET/MIDNIGHT![/b]

    Take heart, Overseer, for the Combat Revamp is coming!

With love,
    --The JNT Team

[b]Merry Christmas, Overseer, and have peace in the World![/b]

notes.title: Important Notice!
notes.content:
Important Notice - Production Rebalance & 10 Day Calendar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161922/f45f2dc3c47e4ae2601311ebe137715d9827b161.png[/img]

Hello, Overseer.

We introduced changes to production rooms. Before the update, all production boosts were based on multipliers with a low base production value. This, unfortunately, didn't play nicely with the rest of the game, since production was rising sharply in later levels for the Shelter, creating a very unbalanced production curve.
This update readjusted the base production for rooms, switching from a multiplier to an additive value, which gave us a more linear, smoother progression.
All tasks, both event and shelter level, that require collecting resources have been readjusted to reflect these changes.
We are carefully monitoring the ultimate outcome of these changes to confirm they worked as intended with our tests, while also awaiting your feedback, which you can freely share on our Discord Server with us. If further tweaks are required in the future, you will be notified of them.

On the bright side, we are also launching our promised 10 Day Calendar with additional rewards for daily logins, among them the much-coveted Vault Coins. We hope, together with Vault Opening events, they will provide a steady form of access to past content as well as new content unlocked through them.

*the requirements of version 1.2.71+

We thank you for your understanding and your continuous support. Good luck in the Wilderness!

Love,
    JNT Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.258
notes.content:
A patch summarizing a week of work on the game was released today. Thank you for your support, suggestions and help!

1.0.257+ (week of 23-27.05)

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix several event issues, with missing tasks, not working tasks etc
[*] Fix eLDi production issues
[*] Fix radio station not producing more than 1 item when offline
[*] Fix training not working when offline
[*] Fix Now I know What It Is Achievement
[*] Fix skip timers incorrect values between backend and frontend
[*] Fix stopping room build providing 50 builders
[*] Fix crafting resources being used extra time when changing girls during enhance in crafting rooms
[*] Fix sexscenes missing control buttons sometimes
[*] Fix daily quests panel showing incorrect points during collection
[*] Fix needing to get 1 extra trust to unlock a girl ("need 0 more trust" issue)
[*] Fix several messed up timers
[*] Fix several exploits
[*] Fix legendary girls being removed from Radio Station queue
[*] Fix quantum-entangled workers
[*] Fix welcome logo not opening correctly on Steam Deck
[*] Fix several save game issues
[*] Fix incorrectly swapping girls in missions selection
[*] Fix chapter 4 level 3 hscene reward
[*] Fix requirement on Shelter level 16
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission resources are now claimed after mission load (so crashes on load will not cause losing resources)
[*] Mission - Chapter 4 Resource 1 fixed
[*] Mission - Gaia Trust Mission Fixed
[/list]
[b]Polishing[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved dragging (and pinching on touch screens) - should properly separate selecting chibi and dragging (dragging from chibi position should work nicely now)
[*] Blocked upgrading expedition room when girls are on expeditions
[/list]
[b]Quality Of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] QoL - girls sorted by primary stat when assigning girls to rooms
[*] QoL - better rooms sorting in Shelter Overview and several fixes there
[*] QoL - adds total Disassenbly Queue time
[*] QoL - shows which Shelter Level is needed to level up Champions
[*] QoL - Trust and Crafting items show their rarity on inventory cards (also makes it clearer what Gacha rewards are given)
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix several typos
[*] Optimization - improved memory usage
[/list]
